name: Boot Safe World Fallback
scope: game-side only: audit stuck boot path and prevent world/module asset stalls from trapping the game on the boot overlay
notes: Audited active boot path: game/index.html is now native-module clean and imports game/main.js with a cache-busted native dynamic import.
Found active risk in game/main.js: boot waited for buildSkylineRoom() before creating hands, teleport, watch, and before calling window.svrBootReady().
Added an 8.5 second timeout around buildSkylineRoom() and a procedural boot-safe fallback lobby so the game opens even when heavy room assets or world construction stalls.
Added a timeout around logo texture loading so missing logo assets cannot block boot completion.
Wrapped watch creation and animation loop with safety guards so failures do not trap the user at Booting.
Fallback lobby preserves table, floor, walls, Moon, Mars, portal labels, seat markers, teleport room clamp, scene targets, and controller/hand boot flow.
No Unity, no Azure, no site public Matrix launch page edits. This is WebXR/WebEx game-side only.
